about: Labelled candidate signals from four company job boards (Nvidia twice, from two saved digests), for the Jobs Page Secret Signals rules in skills/last30days/references/hiring-signals.md. tests lists which of the four tests of the bar a candidate meets (1 out of character, 2 names something concrete, 3 large and hard to undo, 4 bears on a story in the report). public is true when the thing is already publicly announced, false when a web check found nothing, null when it was not checked while labelling. quote is the posting's own words, or null where the label rests on the role or a count. The labels are a person's judgment of saved boards; boards change, so compare a live run by signal, not by exact role. A candidate with a cluster list is three or more postings that share one concrete focus and count together as one signal; its paragraph cites two of them.
